## Moelis Appoints Greg Guest as a Managing Director in its Private Capital Advisory Group


New York


, September 9, 2026


Moelis & Company (NYSE: MC), a leading global independent investment bank, today announced the appointment of Greg Guest as a Managing Director in New York. Greg joins the Firm’s Private Capital Advisory Group, where he will lead its promoted capital solutions effort advising private fund managers and independent sponsors on raising promoted private capital for pre-identified new platform and add-on opportunities. His addition further expands the Firm’s private capital advisory offering across primary capital raising, promoted co-investments and secondary transactions.


Greg brings more than 25 years of experience working with financial sponsors and private fund managers. He joins Moelis from Capital One, where he advised private equity firms and their portfolio companies as Head of Capital Solutions. Previously, Greg spent more than two decades at KKR and Citigroup, serving as a Managing Director at both firms.


Matt Wesley, Global Head of Private Capital Advisory at Moelis, said, “Promoted capital solutions have become an increasingly important part of how sponsors and independent managers fund individual transactions. Greg’s relationships across the sponsor community will strengthen our ability to advise clients on promoted co-investment raises and deal-by-deal capital as we continue to deliver differentiated solutions across our Private Capital Advisory platform.”


## About Moelis & Company


Moelis & Company (“Moelis”) is a leading global independent investment bank that provides innovative strategic advice and solutions to a diverse client base, including corporations, governments, and financial sponsors. The Firm assists its clients in achieving their strategic goals by offering comprehensive integrated financial advisory services across all major industry sectors. Moelis’s experienced professionals advise clients on their most critical decisions, including mergers and acquisitions, recapitalizations and restructurings, capital markets transactions, secondary transactions and primary fundraising, and other corporate finance matters. The Firm serves clients from locations across North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. For further information, please visit:[www.moelis.com](http://www.moelis.com/) .
